scope: The example ex:case-C-p5. Unconditional: Y is a projective integral regular surface over ell = F_5(s_1,s_2) with constants ell, geometrically non-normal, whose differential line has exact order five. Conditional on the two listed general theorems: every canonical sheaf of Y has exact order five, and the Albanese morphism of Y is the structure morphism to Spec ell. Separately: explicit derivations and weights, four-chart nonvanishing, a conditional canonical-sheaf comparison for the input surface, and a conditional rank-five mu-five torsor, none of which the final theorem uses
